purpose: Teach: 小冊子/鉄骨/凝縮/収める/経済学部/新株/チャーター/リクルート

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員配付用の小冊子を新調しましょう
lines.en: Let's commission a new set of staff handbooks.
lines.style: Efficient, clear. Short, purposeful attack on the opening word. Calm professional register. Forward momentum — she's working through a list and expects agreement. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。鉄骨入りの倉庫を建てる計画です
lines.en: Understood. We're moving ahead with the steel-frame warehouse construction plan.
lines.style: Attentive and confirming. Slight nod in the voice on 「はい」. Steady, organized tone. He's demonstrating he's tracking and competent. Measured pace — not rushed, but ready.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様調査を凝縮したレポートを作りましょう
lines.en: Let's put together a condensed report based on the customer survey data.
lines.style: Directive but not sharp. Clear instruction delivered as collaboration. Mid-tempo, confident. She's setting the task with expectation of execution. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。月次目標を着実に収める努力をしております
lines.en: Understood. We're working steadily to hit our monthly targets.
lines.style: Solid, reassuring update. Slight emphasis on 「着実に」 — he's emphasizing reliability. Calm, dependable tone. He's reporting progress without overselling. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 経済学部からインターンを募集しましょう
lines.en: Let's open a recruitment drive for economics interns.
lines.style: Task-focused direction. Clean opening attack. Brief, professional cadence. She's moving through the agenda. Clear expectation without urgency. Efficient register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新株の発行アナウンスを準備しております
lines.en: Understood. We're currently preparing the announcement for the new share issuance.
lines.style: Steady status report. Quiet competence in his delivery. Measured pace — he's keeping her informed of parallel efforts. No lag in his responsiveness. Professional and aligned.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外視察のチャーター便を予約しましょう
lines.en: Let's book a chartered flight for the overseas site visit.
lines.style: Clear mandate. Brisk, decisive. Minimal pause before the instruction lands. Professional register maintained throughout. She's confident in the direction and expects it done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新卒リクルートを強化しております
lines.en: Understood. We're currently ramping up our new graduate recruitment efforts.
lines.style: Final confirmation in a sequence. Calm, attentive close. Slight sense of completion in his tone — he's been keeping pace throughout and this is a natural endpoint. Professional and settled.
